Probable and measurable: provision. Possible: disclose a contingent liability. Remote: do nothing.
A possible asset from a past event that depends on an uncertain future event; disclosed if probable, recognised only when virtually certain.
An obligation created by the company's own actions, for example an announced plan that creates a valid expectation in those affected.
